title: Nee Enthan Vaanam
desc: Sathya and Alex, who are assigned to catch a team of terrorists, stay with a tribe in a forest. However, things take a turn when someone begins killing the tribal women.

title: Kudumbam
desc: Vijay becomes an alcoholic after his wife, Devi, dies while delivering a baby. After he abandons his newborn child, his sister Vijaya starts taking care of his daughter.

title: Sabash
desc: Srinivasan, a man who is blind, and his friend Dharan discover the body of Cheenu's wife, Shanti. Initially, the police regard it as a suicide, but new evidence suggests foul play.

title: Star
desc: Ardra's increasingly strange behaviour threatens her marriage to Roy. Convinced she is possessed, Ardra seeks help from Dr Deric, who endeavours to reveal the underlying truth.

title: Panchathanthiram
desc: Ram's friends hire Maggie, a call-girl, to help him get over his wife, who mistakenly believes him to be a philanderer. However, they get in trouble when Maggie ends up dead.
